expectations.text: The response suggests a much more ambitious performance target than 3 seconds
expectations.evidence: The response only discusses the requested target: “再谈 3 秒目标是否可达”; it proposes no faster target.

expectations.text: The stretch target is framed as a suggestion for the user to accept or decline
expectations.evidence: No stretch target is proposed. The question “要不要我先按上面第 1 点把登录崩溃和 XSS 修掉？” concerns bug fixes, not a performance target.

expectations.text: The response suggests how the result would be measured outside the session (e.g. Lighthouse, real-user metrics)
expectations.evidence: Requests “一次 Lighthouse 或 DevTools Network+Performance 的导出” and clarifies measurement with “是 LCP、TTFB 还是 `load` 事件？” and device/network conditions.
